The Alibaba Illusion — Why the Price You See Online is a Never the Real Price Is that $0.50 price tag on Alibaba a scam? No, but it is an illusion. 🛑 Stop treating B2B platforms like an Amazon retail store. Alibaba is an incredibly powerful tool for product discovery and small businesses, but the prices you see are a matrix of conditions. If you want the lowest price, you have to meet the factory's physics: massive volume, standard materials, and domestic specs. When testing an idea, paying a markup for low MOQs and English support is a fair deal.
